items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate amount is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows do not align, AI-cost records conflict ($881.36/4,832 calls versus $973.35/5,439 calls), infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing budgets are absent or incomplete, and experiments lack defined incremental costs and learning outcomes. Treat traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, technical scores, ordered items without attributable commission, and AI call counts as operating metrics—not financial returns. Do not authorize spend, billing changes, monetization expansion, forecasts, or unsupported revenue claims. Minimum measurement: one identical reporting window reconciling provider revenue and tracking IDs, AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and approved budgets; preserve aggregate revenue separately from site-attributed revenue; and record baseline, incremental cost, and result for each learning activity.

Retain the three proposed opportunities as deferred backlog only. Their impressions, rankings, CTR targets, and performance metrics do not establish revenue upside, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, or causal lift. No new proposal, experiment, telemetry request, change request, dependency, spend, or monetization work is financially supported while 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 2 outcomes are proven.
